test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 19 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper offers two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on an item. If the marked price of the item is 1,200, what is its final selling price?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = 1200

First discount = 20%

Second discount = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Successive discount price = MP × (1 - d1/100) × (1 - d2/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Selling price = 1200 × (1 - 20/100) × (1 - 10/100)

⇒ Selling price = 1200 × 0.8 × 0.9

⇒ Selling price = 1200 × 0.72

⇒ Selling price = 864

**∴ The correct answer is 864.**
